Every machine of an installation boots Spin OS, built for one release of spin. The module reads the image of each machine from the image catalog on spin-terraform-aws's `catalog` branch, through the spin provider, by `spin_version` (a release, or a channel such as `edge`) and region, and boots each role's newest build whose signature it checks. An installation of `v20261121.03` can be made in a region listed here and nowhere else. To boot images of your own, name them with `image_ids` and their measurements with `image_measurements` ([the module's variables](/reference/terraform/root/#image_ids)).

| Region | Control plane | Proxy | Runner |
|---|---|---|---|
| `us-east-1` | `ami-0d977016b390a07c2` | `ami-0bef140948856c37f` | `ami-0002289e5267ef23e` |
| `us-west-2` | `ami-0b064e01218a97ee9` | `ami-032cb3e045d771cb5` | `ami-010878fb797e11398` |
